mapper.insert: INSERT INTO after_sales_case (case_id, run_id, user_id, session_id, user_message, stage, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{caseId}, #{runId}, #{userId}, #{sessionId}, #{userMessage}, #{stage}, NOW(6), NOW(6)) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE updated_at = VALUES(updated_at)
mapper.update: UPDATE after_sales_case SET order_id = #{orderId}, stage = #{stage}, checkpoint_id = #{checkpointId}, next_node = #{nextNode}, terminal_reason = #{terminalReason}, command_id = #{commandId}, updated_at = NOW(6) WHERE run_id = #{runId}
mapper.select: SELECT case_id, run_id, user_id, session_id, user_message, order_id, stage, checkpoint_id, next_node, terminal_reason, command_id FROM after_sales_case WHERE run_id = #{runId}
mapper.update: UPDATE after_sales_case SET stage = 'CANCELLED', terminal_reason = #{reason}, updated_at = NOW(6) WHERE run_id = #{runId} AND stage NOT IN ('COMPLETED', 'REJECTED', 'CANCELLED')
UPDATE after_sales_case SET stage = 'EXECUTE_REFUND', command_id = #{commandId}, updated_at = NOW(6) WHERE case_id = #{caseId}
